method.name: Sourced keyword baseline
method.normalization: Lowercase alphanumeric tokens, fixed stopwords, fixed morphology map (including imaging/images→image, modelling/models→model, surgical→surgery); no learned synonyms. See backend/retrieval.py.
method.scoring: Sum of matched token IDFs / sum of query token IDFs. IDF=1+ln((N+1)/(df+1)); each token counted once per venture.
method.abstention: At least two distinct informative matching tokens and query-token coverage >= 0.15. At most three results; stable venture-ID tie break.
method.limitations: Lexical ranking scores, not probabilities, quality or investment scores. No semantic understanding or validated relevance. Pathway mode searches reported product and university-origin wording, not verified deployment milestones. Awards, proposed annotations and press volume are excluded. Sparse wording may miss useful analogies.

cutoff_semantics: Frozen present-day exploration snapshot; not a historical availability backtest
limits: Candidate pools and distractor suggestions are protocol hypotheses, not relevance judgments
Held-out cohort is explicitly pending independent sourced evidence
